trait.name: Shared Resistances
entries: When you summon the spirit, choose one of its Resistances. You have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to the chosen damage type until the spell ends.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The spirit makes a number of Rend attacks equal to half the spell's level (round down), and it uses Breath Weapon.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atk m} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, reach 10 feet. {@h}{@damage 1d6 + 4 + summonSpellLevel} Piercing damage.

action.name: Breath Weapon
entries: {@actSave dex} DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} {@damage 2d6} damage of a type this spirit has {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to (your choice when you cast the spell). {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

entries: The insect can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The insect makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

action.name: Poison Jab
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, reach 10 ft. {@h}{@damage 1d6 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} Piercing damage plus {@damage 1d4} Poison damage.

entries: {@atkr r} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, range 60 ft. {@h}{@damage 1d10 + 3 + summonSpellLevel} Bludgeoning damage, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} is reduced to 0 until the start of the insect's next turn.

hp.special: 5 + 10 per spell level (the steed has a number of Hit Dice [d10s] equal to the spell's level)

trait.name: Life Bond
entries: When you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} from a level 1+ spell, the steed regains the same number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} if you're within 5 feet of it.

action.name: Otherworldly Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack Bonus equals your spell attack modifier}, reach 5 ft. {@h}{@damage 1d8 + summonSpellLevel} of Radiant (Celestial), Psychic (Fey), or Necrotic (Fiend) damage.

bonus.name: Fell Glare (Fiend Only; Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: {@actSave wis} DC equals your spell save DC, one creature within 60 feet the steed can see. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition until the end of your next turn.

bonus.name: Fey Step (Fey Only; Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: The steed teleports, along with its rider, to an unoccupied space of your choice up to 60 feet away from itself.

bonus.name: Healing Touch (Celestial Only; Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: One creature within 5 feet of the steed regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} equal to {@dice 2d8 + summonSpellLevel}.
